name: jaa serif
description: Traditional CV for academic, public-sector and long-form profiles: centred name, dates and language names in a left margin column, serif type. Breaks cleanly onto a second page. TeX Gyre Pagella, 11pt, A4 (US Letter: one class option).
license: MIT (this repository). Uses only packages and fonts from standard TeX distributions: titlesec, needspace, etoolbox (LPPL) and TeX Gyre Pagella (GUST Font License).
